rows.query: How do I get a refund for a duplicate charge?
rows.answer: If you were charged twice for the same order, contact billing support with your order ID and the two charge dates. Duplicate charges are refunded automatically within 3-5 business days once verified.

rows.query: Where can I find my invoices?
rows.answer: Invoices are available under Account Settings > Billing > Invoice History. You can download any invoice as a PDF from there.

rows.query: I want to download a PDF copy of my bill

rows.query: Do you take PayPal?
rows.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and SEPA direct debit for customers in the EU.

rows.query: My card got billed two times for one purchase
rows.answer: Digital subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if unused beyond the trial features. Physical products can be returned within 30 days in original condition for a full refund.

rows.query: The application crashes whenever I open it
rows.answer: First, make sure you're on the latest version. If the crash continues, clear the app cache under Settings > Storage, then restart your device. If it still crashes, send us the crash log from Settings > Help > Send Diagnostics.

rows.query: I want to stop paying but keep my account for a while
rows.answer: I'm really sorry for the trouble this has caused. Yes. Your old email remains active until the new one is verified.

rows.query: How long will delivery take if I order from abroad?
rows.answer: You can change the delivery address within 1 hour of placing the order via Order History > Edit. After that window, contact support and we'll try to intercept the shipment, though this isn't always possible.

rows.query: Can I switch my shipping address after I've ordered?
rows.answer: Go to Account Settings > Billing > Address, update the fields, and click Save. The new address applies to your next invoice. You may also find this useful: Standard shipping takes 3-7 business days domestically and 7-14 business days internationally. Express shipping (available at checkout) takes 1-3 business days domestically.

rows.query: Is there a discount for university students?
rows.answer: Yes, students with a valid .edu or equivalent institutional email get 50% off any paid plan. Apply under Account Settings > Billing > Student Discount.

rows.query: Does it work with Outlook calendar?
